headline: Longest-serving volunteer helps boost bird numbers
summary: A charity's longest-serving volunteer is helping species recovery, showing how conservation gains can be built through decades of local work.
script: A charity's longest-serving volunteer is helping increase bird numbers, turning decades of local knowledge into conservation work. The charity says his long service has helped support species recovery over time.
